with combined_sales as (
    select c_customer_sk as customer_id,
    c_first_name as customer_first_name,
    c_last_name as customer_last_name,
    c_preferred_cust_flag as customer_preferred_cust_flag,
    c_birth_country as customer_birth_country,
    c_login as customer_login,
    c_email_address as customer_email_address,
    d_year as dyear,
    sum(ss_ext_list_price - ss_ext_discount_amt) as s_year_total,
    's' as sale_type,
    sum(ws_ext_list_price - ws_ext_discount_amt) as w_year_total
    from customer
    join store_sales on c_customer_sk = ss_customer_sk
    and ss_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
    where dyear = 1998
    group by c_customer_sk, c_first_name, c_last_name,
           c_preferred_cust_flag, c_birth_country, c_login, c_email_address, d_year
), 
combined_sales as (
    select c_customer_sk as customer_id,
    c_first_name as customer_first_name,
    c_last_name as customer_last_name,
    c_preferred_cust_flag as customer_preferred_cust_flag,
    c_birth_country as customer_birth_country,
    c_login as customer_login,
    c_email_address as customer_email_address,
    d_year as dyear,
    sum(ws_ext_list_price - ws_ext_discount_amt) as w_year_total,
    'w' as sale_type,
    sum(ss_ext_list_price - ss_ext_discount_amt) as s_year_total
    from customer
    join web_sales on c_customer_sk = ws_bill_customer_sk
    and ws_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk
    where dyear = 1999
    group by c_customer_sk, c_first_name, c_last_name,
           c_preferred_cust_flag, c_birth_country, c_login, c_email_address, d_year
)
select t_1998.customer_id,
       t_1998.customer_first_name,
       t_1998.customer_last_name,
       t_1998.customer_email_address,
       case when t_1999.w_year_total > 0 then t_1999.w_year_total / t_1998.s_year_total else 0.0 end as w_div_s_ratio,
       case when t_1998.s_year_total > 0 then t_1998.s_year_total / t_1999.w_year_total else 0.0 end as s_div_w_ratio
from combined_sales t_1998
join combined_sales t_1999 on t_1998.customer_id = t_1999.customer_id
where t_1998.dyear = 1998 and t_1999.dyear = 1999
and t_1998.s_year_total > 0 and t_1999.w_year_total > 0
order by customer_id, customer_first_name, customer_last_name, customer_email_address
limit 100
